name: Sue
title: A-level Law teacher for 25 years and qualified solicitor
bio: Sue has taught A-level Law for 25 years and is a qualified solicitor. She teaches all the A-level Law exam boards, including the OCR (H418 and H018), AQA (7162) and Cambridge International (9084) specifications, online, one-to-one, to Year 12 and Year 13 students.

Lessons are built around what the mark schemes reward: accurate law with cases and statutes for the AO1 marks, applying that law to each person in a scenario and reaching a conclusion for AO2, and developed, focused evaluation for the AO3 essays.
offers: One-to-one online sessions for Year 12 and Year 13, at a regular weekly slot
Scenario and essay answers marked against the board's levels of response, with written feedback
Timed practice on the long scenario questions and mock-paper walk-throughs before the May and June exams
